articles.title: Adani Green Energy surpasses 20 GW operational RE capacity
articles.summary: AGEL becomes the first Indian company to reach 20 GW of operational renewable energy capacity, predominantly through greenfield development.

articles.title: India's renewable capacity additions rose 25% in H1 2026 to 30.6 GW
articles.summary: Solar dominated with 24.8 GW additions, followed by wind at 3.2 GW. Total RE capacity stands at 288 GW as of June 2026.

articles.title: Major fire at Talcher STPS Unit-4 boiler; no casualties reported
articles.summary: A coal mill fire escalated to the boiler area at NTPC's Talcher Super Thermal Power Station in Odisha. Unit-4 (500 MW) tripped. Damage assessment underway.

articles.title: JSW Energy total capacity reaches 13.2 GW after 114 MW wind commissioning
articles.summary: JSW Energy commissioned 114 MW wind capacity in Karnataka, taking total operational capacity to 13,211 MW across thermal, hydro, wind, and solar.

articles.title: Severe hailstorm damages 180 MW solar modules in Jaisalmer, Rajasthan
articles.summary: Unprecedented hailstorm in Fatehgarh solar park area damaged modules across multiple developers' plants. Estimated loss of ₹80–120 Cr. Insurance claims being filed.

articles.title: Avaada Electro commissions 3 GW TOPCon solar cell line in Nagpur
articles.summary: First line of the 6 GW integrated solar cell manufacturing facility operational. India's push for domestic module+cell self-sufficiency continues.

articles.title: Cyclone 'Aagam' causes blade damage to 12 WTGs in Kutch, Gujarat
articles.summary: Wind speeds of 140 kmph damaged blades on 12 turbines across Adani and ReNew sites. Crane mobilization underway; seasonal wind generation impact expected.

articles.title: NTPC Green Energy IPO oversubscribed 6x; raises ₹10,000 Cr
articles.summary: NTPC's renewable energy arm lists at 22% premium. Proceeds to fund 10 GW solar + wind pipeline over next 3 years.

articles.title: Singrauli STPS turbine rotor failure; Unit-7 (500 MW) shut for 6 months
articles.summary: LP turbine blade failure at NTPC Singrauli. Rotor replacement ordered from BHEL. Estimated repair time 6–8 months. BI claim expected ₹200+ Cr.

articles.title: Serentica Renewables secures 2 GW solar-wind hybrid PPA with MSEDCL
articles.summary: Maharashtra state DISCOM signs largest single RE PPA at ₹3.42/unit. Projects to be commissioned across Rajasthan and Karnataka by Dec 2027.

articles.title: SECI floats 5 GWh battery energy storage tender — largest ever
articles.summary: Solar Energy Corporation of India issues RfP for 5 GWh standalone BESS across 4 states (RJ, GJ, TN, KA). 4-hour storage duration mandated.

articles.title: Flash flood damages Karcham Wangtoo HEP intake; 200 MW offline
articles.summary: Glacial lake outburst in Kinnaur district caused flash flood at Karcham Wangtoo hydro project. Intake structure damaged. JP Power assessing losses.

articles.title: India adds record 52.5 GW capacity in FY26 — 75% from renewables
articles.summary: Ministry of Power confirms highest-ever annual capacity addition. Solar alone added 37.9 GW. India total crosses 530 GW installed base.

articles.title: Transformer explosion at Jhajjar TPS causes ₹45 Cr damage
articles.summary: 220 kV generator transformer exploded due to internal fault at CLP India's Jhajjar plant in Haryana. Oil fire contained; no injuries. Unit offline for 4 months.

articles.title: Greenko to develop 5.2 GWh integrated RE + storage project in Andhra
articles.summary: World's largest integrated renewable energy storage project gets environmental clearance. Combines solar, wind, and pumped hydro storage.

articles.title: 30 WTGs damaged by lightning in Muppandal wind farm, Tamil Nadu
articles.summary: Pre-monsoon lightning activity caused blade tip damage and control panel failures across 30 turbines in the Muppandal-Aralvaimozhi corridor. Estimated loss ₹15 Cr.
